record.reason: GEMINI is a distributed training system for checkpointing model states in host CPU memory and recovering training after failures. Its checkpoint placement and network-traffic scheduling improve recovery speed while preserving training throughput; the paper explicitly targets static synchronous training. It does not study inference-time execution or serving and is outside the inference-focused scope.
record.title: GEMINI: Fast Failure Recovery in Distributed Training with In-Memory Checkpoints
